title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Composite Sketch
what_is_it: Composite sketch produced by the FBI Laboratory overlaying a graphic depiction of eyewitness descriptions onto an actual site photograph.
interpretation_warnings: The PDF source text is entirely unreadable garbled OCR output — all substantive facts are derived solely from the CSV metadata description provided by war.gov, not from the document body itself.
The composite sketch is an artist rendering based on witness testimony, not a photograph of the object.
No raw witness statements, investigator notes, or analytical conclusions are available from the extracted text.
Size estimates (130–195 feet) are eyewitness approximations with no confirmed measurement methodology described.
Single-event, witness-testimony-only evidence with no sensor or instrument data apparent in the available text.
